{"id":2009305495,"question_id":3329,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months","timestamp":1779387935,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"329 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2009305495/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find the Length of the Longest Common Prefix","memory":"152.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int longestCommonPrefix(vector<int>& arr1, vector<int>& arr2) {\n        unordered_set<string>st;\n        for(auto it : arr1)\n        {\n            string s = \"\";\n            string num = to_string(it);\n            for(auto ch : num)\n            {\n                s += ch;\n                st.insert(s);\n            }\n        }\n\n        int ans = INT_MIN;\n        for(auto it : arr2)\n        {\n            string s = \"\";\n            string num = to_string(it);\n            for(auto ch : num)\n            {\n                s += ch;\n                int len = s.size();\n                if(st.count(s)) ans = max(ans , len);\n            }\n        }\n        return ans == INT_MIN ? 0 : ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-the-length-of-the-longest-common-prefix","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2019}
